cards.name: [High Quality Print]
cards.summary: Desktop-printer / proofer PDF. Per its .joboptions: Acrobat 5 (PDF 1.4), colour left unchanged, colour and grey images bicubic-downsampled to 300 ppi (above 450 ppi) with automatic JPEG, mono images 1200 ppi, all fonts embedded and subset, no PDF/X check, no output intent.
use_for: proof prints on office, inkjet or laser printers
client review PDF with full vector quality and print-grade images
high-quality handouts and presentation prints
avoid: commercial offset print: colour is not converted and there is no output intent; use [PDF/X-4:2008] or [Press Quality]
email or web: 300 ppi images make large files; use [Smallest File Size]
a font that cannot be embedded only raises a warning (CannotEmbedFontPolicy Warning); check fonts or outline type before sending
cards.applies_to: an open document written out as a PDF (Save As / Save a Copy, all artboards or a range); requires an open document; changes only the PDF that is written, not the artwork.
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: File > Save As (or Save a Copy) > Adobe PDF (pdf), then pick '[High Quality Print]' in the Adobe PDF Preset menu; view, duplicate or export it in Edit > Adobe PDF Presets... Script: var o = new PDFSaveOptions(); o.pDFPreset = "[High Quality Print]"; doc.saveAs(file, o).

verified.note: No thumbnail (not visual: PDF export settings); every quoted setting checked against the batch .joboptions params and matches.

cards.name: [PDF/X-1a:2001]
cards.summary: Strict CMYK print-exchange PDF. use_for: magazine and newspaper ad submissions that demand PDF/X-1a
CMYK-only offset jobs for older RIPs

avoid: artwork with transparency, shadows, glows or opacity masks: it is flattened, which can rasterise areas and show stitching lines; use [PDF/X-4:2008]
RGB or colour-managed content that should stay device-independent: it converts to CMYK; use [PDF/X-4:2008]
European / ISO presses: the output intent is US SWOP; change it to the printer's profile
edge-to-edge art without bleed: set bleed in Document Setup and tick Use Document Bleed Settings in Marks and Bleeds

cards.name: Black & White
cards.id: Save for Web Settings/Color Tables/Black & White.act
cards.summary: Save for Web colour table of exactly 2 entries, black (0,0,0) and white (255,255,255) (772-byte .act, count 2, no transparent index). Loaded into a GIF / PNG-8 export it reduces the artwork to 1-bit black and white, with greys turned into dither or hard thresholds by the Dither setting.
use_for: 1-bit line-art GIF / PNG-8: tiny icons, stamps, fax or e-ink style graphics
a hard monochrome, threshold-style web graphic
avoid: photos, gradients and soft shadows: they posterise or dither to noise; use the Grayscale table
anti-aliased edges become stair-stepped; use a 256-colour table or PNG-24
cards.applies_to: GIF or PNG-8 output from File > Export > Save for Web (Legacy) (the artboard or selection is rasterised at export); it does not change the vector artwork.
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: File > Export > Save for Web (Legacy)..., set the format to GIF or PNG-8, then Color Table panel menu > Load Color Table... and pick C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Presets/en_US/Save for Web Settings/Color Tables/Black & White.act.

verified.note: No thumbnail (not visual: indexing palette); colour entries re-read from the .act bytes and match the card.
